name: Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products primarily in China. It offers pharmaceutical products in the areas of anesthesia and analgesic, endocrine system, enteral parenteral nutrition, cardiovascular, psychiatric, tumor-related, digestive liver, and other diseases. Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. has licensing and research collaboration with Eli Lilly and Company to develop medicines across multiple therapeutic areas. The company was formerly known as Xizang Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Haisco Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. in March 2016.
